description: Hangman online free: guess the hidden word one letter at a time. Six wrong guesses and the little figure is complete — every word comes with a hint.
lede: One hidden word, one hint, and six wrong guesses. Pick a letter: if it is in the word, it lights up in green; if it is not, another piece of the little figure appears on the gallows. Find the whole word before the figure is complete — and every word is a common one you already know.

p: Press Start guessing and a hidden word appears as blank lines, together with a hint like “Animal” or “Fruit” that tells you the topic. Tap a letter on the screen keyboard, or type it on your own keyboard. A right letter fills in everywhere it appears; a wrong letter adds a piece to the figure on the gallows.

You get six wrong guesses. Find every letter before the sixth wrong one and you win; complete the figure first and the word is revealed. A new word is picked for every game, so no two rounds are ever the same.
The figure is built one piece at a time, in the same order every game — so you always know exactly how close you are to losing.

sections.h: A game older than the computer
p: Hangman has been played on paper for well over a century — children in Victorian classrooms were already filling in blanks and drawing the gallows long before anyone had a screen to play on. The earliest printed mention dates to 1894, and the game spread because it needs nothing but a pencil, a piece of paper, and a word worth guessing.

It survives because the tension is perfect: every letter is a small gamble, and the drawing makes the stakes visible. This version keeps that spirit, adds a hint so no round is ever unfair, and only ever picks common words — so a loss is always about the guesses, never about an obscure word you could not have known.

ol: Start with the most common letters: E, A, R, I, O, T, N, S and L cover most English words.
Use the hint. If it says “Fruit”, think of fruit words first — it narrows the whole list at once.
Vowels first: a word with no vowel revealed is still a mystery, and one vowel often unlocks the shape of the word.
When two or three letters are showing, say the word out loud in your head — the missing letters often suggest themselves.
With two wrong guesses left, stop guessing rare letters like Q, Z and X. Play the letters that are most likely to be in the word.

p: If you like racing the clock instead of thinking it through, test your typing speed in [[typing-speed-test]]. For another word game with coloured clues, guess the five-letter word in [[wordle]]. You can find every word game in [[cat:word|word games]].

faq: How many wrong guesses do I get?
Six. Each wrong letter adds one piece to the figure: head, body, two arms, two legs. The sixth wrong guess ends the game.
What does the hint tell me?
The topic of the word — Animal, Fruit, Sport, Place, and so on — plus how many letters the word has. It never gives away a letter.
No. Every answer is a common, everyday word, and the hint always points at the topic. There are no obscure words.
Can I use my own keyboard?
Yes. Type any letter on your physical keyboard, or tap the letters on the screen keyboard — both work the same way.
